concepts.name: Computer Network 2.1 Unit Overview As It
concepts.simple_definition: 36 Unit 2 : Computer Network 2.1 Unit Overview As it was defined and discussed in grade 9, unit 2, the computer network is the connection of two or more computers or communication devices connected by transmission media and guided by a set of rules for communication purposes that allow users to communicate with each other and share applications and data
concepts.deep_explanation: The fundamental components of a network are devices, media, messages and protocols
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Computer Network 2.1 Unit Overview As it from page 43.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Computer Network 2.1 Unit Overview As it with adjacent topics in Chapter 2.
concepts.name_amharic: Computer Network 2.1 Unit Overview As it (በአማርኛ)
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] 36 Unit 2 : Computer Network 2.1 Unit Overview As it was defined and discussed in grade 9, unit 2, the computer network is the connection of two or more computers or communication devices connected by transmission media and guided by a set of rules for communication purposes that allow users to communicate with each other and share applications and data (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ10ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] The fundamental components of a network are devices, media, messages and protocols — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 43 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: [አማርኛ] ተማሪዎች ይህንን ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ከሌሎች ተዛማጅ ርዕሶች ጋር ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ።
